Name: Better Saves Menu
Author: OMEGAlinc
Description:
Adds some new quality of life features to the load saves menu.

[img]https://i.ibb.co/tMv20P2F/features.png[/img]
[b][size=4]    • Search[/size][/b]
[size=4][b]    • Drag to rearrange[/b][b]     [/b][/size]
[b][size=4]    • Selection mode[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]    • Bulk delete saves[/size][/b]
[b][size=4]    • Export a summary of info about your saves[/size][/b]


[img]https://i.ibb.co/kxFc96g/compatibility.png[/img]
Compatible with Stardew Valley 1.6.14+.
Compatible with SMAPI 4.4.0+.


[img]https://i.ibb.co/d47w6r80/installation.png[/img]
Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].
Put the [b]BetterSavesMenu [/b]folder into [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b].
Load [b]Stardew Valley[/b] using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url].﻿
